name: Kingdom of Vientiane
native: ອານາຈັກວຽງຈັນ

predecessors.name: Lan Xang
predecessors.text: the central and southern part of Lan Xang, which kept Vientiane after the partition of 1707

successors.name: Rattanakosin Kingdom (Siam)
successors.text: the Vientiane shape, annexed by Siam in 1828

ledger.x: 1707: the Kingdom of Vientiane is formed.
1707: Lan Xang divides into Vientiane and Luang Prabang.
1828: the Kingdom of Vientiane is obliterated.

wars.name: Burmese conquest of the Lao kingdoms
wars.outcome: Vientiane's Ong Boun invited the Burmese against Luang Prabang in October 1764; Nemyo Thihapate 'conquered Lao kingdoms of Luang Prabang and Vientiane in March 1765' and both became Burmese vassals ('a Burmese vassal from 1765 to 1779').

wars.name: Luang Prabang-Vientiane war and Burmese intervention
Siamese conquest of Vientiane and Champasak
wars.outcome: Surasi took Champasak and the Phra Bang in 1778; Vientiane fell in March 1779 and became a Siamese dependency; Ong Boun was executed in 1781 and Nanthasen made king.

wars.name: Tây Sơn invasion of Vientiane
wars.outcome: 'In 1791, Vientiane was invaded by the Vietnamese Tây Sơn dynasty to root out Lê dynasty loyalists'; Nanthasen later reached an accommodation with the Tây Sơn.

wars.name: Lao rebellion (1826-1828)
wars.outcome: Siamese victory: Vientiane was destroyed and annexed in 1828 and its population moved to the Khorat Plateau; Siam consolidated control over Vientiane and Champasak.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line: the borders with Luang Prabang, Champasak and Cambodia are approximate, and the Khorat Plateau part of the shape is a Cliopatria outline that no page opened bounds.
